replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
I apologise for the video not being that clear , as yes i was originally watching your friend , but not exactly like i can re-record it :P

The time frames we are looking at are 00:5-0:10
and 0:47

At the start , I've watched this a couple of time on 0,25 speed you take 0 kb ; continue to walk forward  and swing , not showing any signs of lag. You then turn around again take no kb once you are hit and also hit him from behind but we will disregard that as you are not banned for killaura. If the kb you 'apparently' see is from your sprint jumping the opposite way to which you are hit you have some very odd interpretations of kb i'm afraid,

Then we move  on to 0:47 you take 0 kb when shot , not moving at all and stay rooted to the ground. 
"if an arrow shoots you from above it doesn't move you back that far" Correct. You didn't move whatsoever however.

Too much suspicious and clear evidence in one run. Also as is stated ,  you ban evaded right after being banned which won't help you.
Appeal Denied
Will lock in 24 hours if no response given
